name: Sheikh Safi al-din Khānegāh and Shrine Ensemble in Ardabil
description: In the northwestern Iranian city of Ardabil, this Sufi retreat grew around the tomb of Sheikh Safi al-Din over about three centuries. Visitors walk a path of seven sections divided by eight gates, echoing the stages and attitudes of Sufi mysticism. Beyond the richly decorated facades and interiors, the complex holds a mosque, school, library, hospital, kitchens, bakery and a cistern.
